title: fix(i18n): the Connect page says an AI assistant connected with an API key cannot build apps
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5yo2b3vJWa5A5SkyFevguz)_

Fixes #32904

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「连接 AI 助手」页面上 API 密钥一节的说明，以及四个客户端（Codex、WorkBuddy、豆包工作、千问办公）在没有浏览器登录时改用 API 密钥的提示，现在都写明：用密钥连接的助手只能处理记录和运行操作，不能构建应用。11 种语言都改了。
- 为什么改：服务器从不给 API 密钥连接开放构建应用的工具，原文案却只说「密钥等同于你的身份」，容易让人以为用密钥也能搭应用。按 cloud#4329 的裁决 B，文案不得承诺用 API 密钥构建。
- 风险与回滚：只改 5 个已有文案键的取值，不加键、不改代码；繁体由简体重新生成。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/developer/zh-Hans.ts` 和 `en.ts` 里的 `connectAgent.apiKey.body` 与 `connectAgent.codex.hint`。
- 两分钟验证：打开 设置 → 连接 AI 助手，选 Codex，展开「高级：脚本与 CI」，预期提示和密钥说明里都有「不能构建应用」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：已按 pm-dispatch 审核清单核对：只改了 5 个现有文案的值，11 种语言齐全，繁体由简体生成；新句子与服务端事实一致（API 密钥的授权不含搭建工具），没有任何地方承诺能搭建。可落地。

## What changes

The wording arm of ruling B on objectstack-ai/cloud#4329 (comment 6826838112): values only, no new key, no component change. The console cannot tell whether a build door is mounted from any read it already makes (`ConnectAgentWidget.tsx` reads only `routes.mcp` from `/api/v1/discovery`), so the conditional arm was not open without a new request.

Five keys change in every locale: `connectAgent.apiKey.body` and the four API-key fallback hints `connectAgent.codex.hint`, `connectAgent.workbuddy.hint`, `connectAgent.doubao.hint` and `connectAgent.qwenwork.hint`. Each hint gains one sentence right after the pointer to the Advanced section; the body gains one sentence before "shown once".

**What it agrees with.** The framework half (#32902) says an API key's grant never admits the authoring family: `grantsAuthoringTools` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:2272`) admits only a grant array holding `metadata:write`, and an API key's grant is undefined (`packages/mcp/src/types.ts:134` and `:163`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1645`, and `packages/mcp/CHANGELOG.md` under 2dfb780). So the new sentence is true on every deployment. It promises building nowhere, not even through browser sign-in, so it holds where no build door is mounted. A host that mounts one says how to build in its own `dataOnlyInstructions`; the page does not restate that.

**Vocabulary.** "Build apps" uses each pack's existing word for it (`build.title` / `build.noCapability` in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: 构建应用, Apps erstellen, crear aplicaciones, créer des applications, アプリを作る, 앱 만들기, criar aplicativos, создавать приложения, إنشاء التطبيقات). "Records" and "actions" are the words `connectAgent.capabilities.body` already uses in each pack.

**en, before → after**

- `apiKey.body`: "For CI, scripts, and agents without a browser. The key acts as you — treat it like a password. It is shown ONCE." → "For CI, scripts, and agents without a browser. The key acts as you — treat it like a password. An AI assistant connected with a key works with records and actions only; it cannot build apps. It is shown ONCE."
- Each of the four hints, after "(create one under Advanced: scripts and CI below).", gains: "With a key, your assistant works with records and actions only and cannot build apps."

**zh-Hans, before → after**

- `apiKey.body`: "用于 CI、脚本和无浏览器的智能体。密钥等同于你的身份,请像密码一样保管,且仅显示一次。" → "用于 CI、脚本和无浏览器的智能体。密钥等同于你的身份,请像密码一样保管。用密钥连接的 AI 助手只能处理记录和运行操作,不能构建应用。密钥仅显示一次。"
- Each of the four hints, after "(在下方「高级：脚本与 CI」中创建)。", gains: "使用密钥时,助手只能处理记录和运行操作,不能构建应用。"

In de, fr, pt-BR and ru the closing "shown once" sentence now names the key ("Der Schlüssel wird …", "La clé n’est affichée …", "A chave é mostrada …", "Ключ показывается …"), because after the new sentence a bare pronoun would read as the assistant.

`zh-Hant.ts` is generated: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` wrote it from `zh-Hans.ts` (the other two zh-Hant files were already current).

**Changeset:** `.changeset/32904-api-key-cannot-build-copy.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

No new test: the change is copy, and no consumer parses it. The existing pins that read these keys all hold. Runs on `c6b5bd8d` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, with the `@object-ui/i18n^...` closure built first:

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/`: Test Files 102 passed, Tests 1894 passed, 13 skipped. That covers all-locales key parity, placeholder parity and the de quote pairing.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`: Test Files 5 passed, Tests 110 passed. That includes `ConnectAgentWidget.keyName-13355.test.tsx` §2 (no English copies), §3 (no protocol word outside a client form) and §4 (every API-key hint names the Advanced section, in every pack).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wording arm, not conditional arm.** The page has no existing read that tells whether a build door is mounted, and the order forbids a new request for it. So there is no build hint anywhere, and no conditional pin is owed.
- **Three more API-key strings, out of scope.** `console.developer.agentConnect.keyHint` and `.sendAs` (the Integrations page's "Connect an AI agent" card) and `console.developer.apiConsole.authExternal` also describe a key as acting with your permissions. They do not promise building either, and they are outside this card's named keys, so they are unchanged.
- **The ruling-word grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over the surface hit the `⛔ Keep the declaration` header note in `en.ts` and `zh-Hans.ts` (and the same note in each of the other eight hand-written packs), plus three header notes in `developer/index.ts` (pack keys, loader spelling, read the header). None is touched: declarations, exports and loaders are unchanged.
